title: Real-time Payments and APP Fraud Emerging Globally According to New Aite-Novarica Group and Outseer Report
body_1: BEDFORD, MA – May 10, 2023 – Outseer, a leading provider of digital fraud prevention and customer authentication solutions, announced today the availability of new global research conducted by the Aite-Novarica Group focused on global trends in real-time payments (RTP) and associated fraud. The research shows that 71% of financial institutions (FIs) indicated an increase in consumer account takeover (ATO) using RTP rails from 2021 to 2022, and 62% of financial institutions said that consumer authorized push payment (APP) fraud via RTP rails had increased in the same period. 57% of FIs indicated mule account activity over RTP rails was up in 2022 vs. 2021. “A layered approach for fraud mitigation that combines authentication and payment fraud prevention is more important than ever to effectively mitigate RTP fraud,” says John Filby, Outseer CEO. Additional insights and recommendations include: Learn more about the study findings and how the Outseer platform can help your organization mitigate RTP fraud by getting a copy of the report, Faster Payments, Faster Fraud , or register for the June 6th webinar with Julie Conroy, Aite-Novarica Group’s Head of Risk Insights and Advisory, and Scott Olson, CMO of Outseer. Aite-Novarica Group report, sponsored by Outseer, surveyed fraud executives at large FIs in February and March 2023 in Brazil, Canada, India, the U.K., and the U.S. to understand the trends associated with fraud on faster payment rails. Aite-Novarica Group augmented these efforts by examining the progression of faster payments in each market. title: Outseer Announces 2024 Global Fraud & Scams Trends Report

The report is based on data collected and analyzed from Outseer’s FraudAction 24/7 Anti-Fraud Command Center (AFCC), which is comprised of a team of experts who continuously monitor global threats and protect the brands of our clients. Built with over 20 years of experience in the fraud industry, it is the largest and longest-standing fraud operations center in the world. The AFCC reviews over 2.4 billion URLs and over 18 million compromised emails, as well as detects over 200 thousand attacks annually. title: Outseer Announces 2024 Trends in Faster Payments Fraud Report
body_1: BURLINGTON, MA – June 22, 2024 – Outseer, a leader in providing fraud solutions that protect financial accounts from login through payment, announced the availability of a new global research report conducted by Datos Insights, focused on the global trends in real-time payments and the associated fraud. The 2024 report examines the trends in growth in real-time and non-real-time payments, how those trends influence corresponding rates of growth in different fraud typologies, and how these fraud trends affect efforts among fraud leaders across different markets to modernize and respond to these challenges. The report includes analyses of these market forces, their implications, and likely outcomes in terms of forecasted patterns and anticipated responses. The research showed that 94% of firms saw an increase in real-time payments, up from 71% a year earlier, with the expectation that they will continue to increase – over half of respondents expect the growth rate to be 25% or higher. However, the growth in payments continues to come with a corresponding growth in fraud, with 80% reporting an increase in mule activity. At the top of mind for fraud executives are APP fraud at 82%, ATO at 56%, and CNP fraud at 28%. How are global executives combatting this growth in fraud? 91% say they are monitoring inbound payment activity, and that mitigating threats across platforms makes that easier to manage. 91% say consolidation amplifies the value of signal detection, and 87% agree that it reduces operating costs. Additionally, 57% have already consolidated some aspect of their fraud management systems, with many more planned. “It is clear that banks are placing a high priority on addressing escalating scams and preparing for the liability shifts for banks to reimburse scammed consumers,” says John Filby, Outseer CEO. “Increased sophistication across real-time payments, especially in the areas of mule detection, scam models, signal orchestration and customer interventions is essential to address these new threats.
